historical_diagnostic: Every clean endpoint of the previous PROTEINS and ENZYMES study. Reconstruct the matching initial bank for both repetitions and both peer counts. Compare to central WL + K-means fitted only on the same train role.
kmeans: scikit-learn Lloyd, 10 initializations, up to 300 iterations, tol=0.0001; same train-only depth-2 512-bin WL-TFIDF as live study. A pooled representation diagnostic with a different fit budget.
online: Same initialized bank, partitions, proposal inputs and design/audit RNG streams in paired arms. On each arm state both rankings use the same screened design-feasible family. J-Rank chooses by summed individual upper-J, then sorted mask. Each live arm evolves independently after its own commit decisions.
replay: Use the VCIA/IID state before the six prespecified rounds. Both rankings see identical candidates, and each fixed selected mask sees both separately timed audit types. Record single-update counterfactual outer predictions, with no pathway to online decision; hold uses pre-update prediction. Alternate audit timing order on odd/even round numbers.
audit_reference: IID draws independently of design with replacement from the same held-out finite audit role. Census evaluates that complete finite audit role with the same drift and assignment thresholds. Finite feasibility yields error denominators for sampled audit; this is not a population-level guarantee.
timing: Single-process CPU, one BLAS thread. Report design/audit probe preparation, software cache inference/assembly, audit decision, proposal and commit; exclude reference scoring, outer inference and file I/O. New arm comparisons carry no network measurement.
label_usage: Training labels allocate client shards; outer test labels are passed to a separate scorer after NPZ execution seal. ACC and macro-F1 use independent Hungarian matching on the scored outer test. NMI/ARI are label permutation invariant. Number of occupied predicted clusters and smallest occupied cluster share are reported.
